I, Riley Foster, am the tenant under an indefinite ordinary residential lease for Synthetic Rosenweg 33, 8008 Zurich, canton Zurich. The landlord is Synthetische Wohnraum AG. Current monthly net rent is CHF1800; the landlord maintains the fixed central heating and circulation pump. The lease requires usable heated living rooms in winter.

My active request is removal of the continuing heating defect and assessment of proportional rent-reduction eligibility from the landlord's first knowledge until remedy. I report no incurred monetary loss, no health-compensation claim, no self-help expense and no deposit/withholding request. The repair is not complete; no reduction percentage or award has been agreed.
